nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the privileged role in _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping tracking token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner/spender allowances; decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom and set to uint(-1) for the UNI router in the constructor.
Privileged address whitelisted in ensure(); only settable by the owner via setTradeAddress.
Mapping marking addresses as allowed sellers/whitelisted in ensure(); granted by _mints.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and compared against _saleNum in condition().
Sale-count limit configured by init and enforced in condition().
Minimum sale amount limit configured by init and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale amount limit configured by init and enforced in condition().
Total token supply set in the constructor as _supply * 10**decimals.
Constant whitelisted Uniswap router address (0x7a25...) checked in ensure() and pre-approved in the constructor.
Public payable entry point that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transfer routine that checks allowance, calls ensure(), then mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval routine writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any guard.
Internal whitelist gate that returns true for owner, UNI, the computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits against _onSaleNum and the transfer value.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or hardcoded address 0x1461045492991056468287016484048686824852249628073.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only batch distribution loop that computes total with unchecked multiplication and mutates balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB.
Payable constructor assigning name/symbol/supply, setting owner = msg.sender, minting to the deployer and pre-approving the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance checks and balance mutations.
Low-level delegatecall executed on an arbitrary target address with arbitrary calldata inside delegate().
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom, executed without SafeMath after an ensure/balance require.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length and unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, used for allowance checks, ensure() and balance debit.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom, used for ensure() and balance credit.
Amount parameter of transferFrom flowing into allowance/balance arithmetic and event emission.
Recipient address parameter of _mints whose balance and canSale flag are modified.
Mint amount parameter of _mints multiplied by 10**decimals.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend iterated in the distribution loop.
Local variable total in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Target address parameter of delegate() passed directly to delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate() passed directly to delegatecall.
Address parameter of setTradeAddress assigned to the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the owner during construction, establishing the privileged role from an untrusted input.
msg.sender becomes the owner state variable, which gates privileged functions.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used to consume allowance, so allowance checks depend on caller identity.
msg.sender is checked in _mints against owner and a hardcoded privileged address.
init() reverts unless msg.sender is the owner; caller controls whether sale parameters can be set.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before the distribution loop executes.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before modifying the whitelist.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) as its whitelist/limit gate.
ensure() falls back to condition(_from,_value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() reads owner to bypass the sale restrictions for privileged addresses.
ensure() reads tradeAddress to bypass the sale restrictions.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale restrictions for whitelisted sellers.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure() calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair for the given factory and WETH.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether sale-count limits apply.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked -= and += operations.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
The unchecked balance debit path in transferFrom is the unsafe arithmetic operation.
transferFrom consumes allowance using msg.sender as the spender identity.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without validation.
approve indexes the allowance mapping with the untrusted msg.sender.
delegate() performs a delegatecall, the unsafe privileged execution primitive.
The target address parameter a flows directly into the delegatecall destination.
The calldata parameter b flows directly into the delegatecall payload.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals for privileged callers.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist status.
_mints reads owner for its authorization check.
init() writes the _minSale limit state variable.
init() writes the _maxSale limit state variable.
init() writes the _saleNum limit state variable.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] in a loop with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend contains the unchecked multiplication and subtraction counted as an unsafe arithmetic operation.
batchSend uses msg.sender both for the owner requirement and as the debited account.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable, which bypasses ensure().
The constructor assigns the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
The constructor mints the entire totalSupply to the deployer's balanceOf entry.
The constructor writes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
The constructor pre-approves the UNI router with uint(-1) in the allowance mapping.
Parameter _from is the subject of the allowance and balance lookups in transferFrom.
Parameter _to receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
Parameter _value drives the unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Parameter _from is fed into ensure() and therefore controls the whitelist bypass decision.
Parameter spender is the account whose balance and canSale flag _mints modifies.
Parameter addedValue is scaled by 10**decimals and written as the new balance in _mints.
Parameter _tos is iterated as the recipient list in batchSend.
Local variable total is the product of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Parameter addr is assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from only exists to drive the allowance, ensure and balance logic of transferFrom and has no independent semantic role.
Parameter _to is only used as the balance-credit recipient inside transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount that flows into the unchecked subtraction of balanceOf[_from] in transferFrom.
Parameter spender is only the target of the balance write and canSale assignment in _mints.
Parameter addedValue is only the magnitude scaled and written by _mints.
Parameter _tos is only the recipient array iterated by the batchSend loop.
Local variable total is the intermediate result of the unchecked multiplication inside batchSend.
Parameter a is only used as the destination of the delegatecall in delegate().
Parameter b is only used as the calldata payload of the delegatecall in delegate().
Parameter addr is only used to write the tradeAddress state variable inside setTradeAddress.
